description: PomBase: look up a curated S. pombe publication by its PubMed id (e.g. "PMID:11739790") and return its title, citation, authors, year, abstract, and how many genes it annotates. Keyless.

pmid.description: A PubMed id, with or without the "PMID:" prefix, e.g. "PMID:11739790" or "11739790".
